review_scope: Contact-sheet review of all50 photographs, current human crops, correct references and actual crop winners.
findings: Most severe examples retain the visible target while the competing artwork shares instruction-panel structure. This is a hypothesis to compare with the intervention results, not a causal label by appearance alone.
Examples include brand/design, dose, quantity and side-panel differences. Shared-looking sides are not assumed identical or uninformative.
causal_scope: Multiple observed intervention responses can coexist; no claim of unique semantic roots.
